title: A Study of Live Tumor Fragments of Surgical Resections
official: Predicting Response to Therapy From Analysis of Live Tumor Fragments of Surgical Resections
summary: The purpose of this study is to obtain unused resected tumor tissue sample and associated clinical data from patients enrolled in this study to research ex vivo treatment response and integrity of tumor microenvironment using omics analysis and imaging while maintaining cell stability in a live environment.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Ability to understand and sign informed consent
* Planning to undergo a surgical procedure to remove cancer

Exclusion Criteria:

* Does not meet Inclusion criteria
* No tissue for research available at time of surgery
